# `vl expose`

Make matching paths public

```text
vl expose [OPTIONS] <PATTERNS>...
```

Arguments:

| | |
|---|---|
| `<PATTERNS>…` | Paths or glob patterns (required) |

Options:

| | |
|---|---|
| `--force` | Also allow built-in secret paths and disable secret scanning |
